title: A default value
prompt: Write `show_score`, which takes a score and a bonus, where bonus has a default of 0, and prints their sum. In `solve`, call it once with just the score and once with the score and a bonus of 10, so solve(5) prints 5 then 15.
hints: A default is written in the definition after an = sign; the caller may leave that parameter out.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
